description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class 'AttributesNotModifiableException' used within the Eclipse Ditto framework. The exception indicates that the attributes of a 'Thing' cannot be modified due to insufficient permissions. It includes builder methods and JSON serialization support, and it extends a runtime exception with additional metadata.

classes.name: AttributesNotModifiableException
classes.description: A final class representing an exception thrown when attributes cannot be modified, indicating a permissions issue. It is immutable and extends DittoRuntimeException, implementing ThingException, with builder pattern support and JSON parsing capabilities.

classes.name: AttributesNotModifiableException.Builder
classes.description: A builder class for creating instances of AttributesNotModifiableException with a fluent API, supporting customization of message, description, cause, headers, and hyperlink.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new mutable builder instance for AttributesNotModifiableException, initialized with the provided ThingId.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates an instance of AttributesNotModifiableException with a simple message and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an instance from a JSON object, extracting error details from the JSON.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a copy of the exception with updated Ditto headers.
